services.desc: ​Have you ever wanted to get up close to a dolphin? How about 300 of them? Our Jetski2Catalina Adventure and Jetski Coastal Tour put you in the middle of Pacific Dolphins pods that are playful, curious, and ready to entertain you, right next to your jetski! It will be a journey that you will never forget. Escape the chaos of Southern California on your own Day-cation in Catalina Island. This is the adventure you have been waiting for!​​​​​ Experience the untamed beauty of Catalina Island on our exclusive Two Harbors Adventure. services.desc: The Catalina Island jet ski trip is more than an ordeal across the waves; it is an adventure in its own way, filled with breathtaking sceneries, marine life encounters, and unforgettable experiences. Whether an adrenaline junkie, wanting to relax, or experience both-this different journey got something for all. Here is what you expect when you book a JetSki2Catalina tour. Your adventure starts by firing up your jet ski and heading out from Long Beach toward Catalina Island. It is an open ocean that gives this feeling of freedom, with excitement as one glides across the waves-the sea breeze in your face and the sun on your skin. blurb: Guests ride jetskis guided by experienced staff from Long Beach to Catalina Island or along the coast. The full-day Catalina trips include about 1.5 hours jetski ride each way and 3 hours free time on the island. The coastal tour is a 2-hour guided jetski ride along the California coast from Palos Verdes to Huntington Pier.
